source_claims.paraphrase: AIF is an abstract common representation; direct mappings may better preserve specific semantics.
source_claims.wag_implication: Keep a native evidence contract and versioned interchange mappings.

source_claims.paraphrase: Information nodes and applications of inference, conflict and preference schemes differ; edge roles and directional conflict matter.
source_claims.wag_implication: Do not identify artifacts with propositions or flatten general conflict into symmetric opposition without an explicit policy.

source_claims.paraphrase: Exactly one conclusion-role successor in the definition differs from at most one in the prose.
source_claims.wag_implication: Name the chosen conformance profile and test it.

locator.printed: p.3 explanation of local predecessor/successor condition

source_claims.paraphrase: Local predecessor/successor constraints do not rule out a scheme-only cycle.
source_claims.wag_implication: Any global reachability or acyclicity requirement is additional and explicit.

source_claims.paraphrase: Evidence criteria depend on task/domain and dialogue; a working implementation of the proposed special evidence treatment remains open.
source_claims.wag_implication: Make evidential use and policy scope explicit; admission is not unconditional truth.

source_claims.paraphrase: A recorded sensor value differs from the world claim inferred from it.
source_claims.wag_implication: Preserve artifact, transformation and assertion identities; byte integrity alone does not establish authenticity.

source_claims.paraphrase: A broad CQ-default claim is followed by distinct effects for assumption challenges and evidence-backed exception allegations.
source_claims.wag_implication: Use question-specific NASCQ burden contracts.

source_claims.paraphrase: Inquiry can revise accepted claims; absence-of-evidence reasoning needs a detection/completeness warrant.
source_claims.wag_implication: Keep history and uncertainty; failed capture is not evidence of a substantive negative.

source_claims.paraphrase: The book describes pre-version-4 CAS; the Leonardo case was not computationally evaluated and cumulative modeling is acknowledged as unresolved.
source_claims.wag_implication: Treat case reconstruction as new work, not a certified modern runtime oracle.

source_claims.paraphrase: The conjunction-fallacy discussion misleadingly invokes independence and presents the probability calculus as causing the error.
source_claims.wag_implication: Set inclusion proves the conjunction bound without independence; compare probabilistic models on their actual assumptions.

source_claims.paraphrase: Coherent explanations need evidential anchors, comparison with alternatives and a judgment about further investigation.
source_claims.wag_implication: Keep observed data, reconstructed explanations and added assumptions distinct.

source_claims.paraphrase: A red bean is described beside a bag of white beans on p.58. The next page repeats that the bag contains white beans but does not explain the color mismatch or explicitly change the individual bean to white.
source_claims.wag_implication: Record a likely textual error or unaddressed exception. Under an explicit all-white-bag assumption, treat the red observation as contrary evidence; label a corrected white-bean fixture separately.
source_claims.review_note: Root independently checked the full text of printed p.59/PDF71; the synthesis author then re-read printed pp.58–59/PDF70–71. The earlier claim that p.59 changes the individual bean to white was unsupported and has been removed.

source_claims.paraphrase: Different inferences from conduct, character and inconsistent commitments require different targets and warrants.
source_claims.wag_implication: Do not use one criticism as unrestricted global source discrediting or proof of the opposite conclusion.

source_claims.paraphrase: Structured argumentation separates knowledge, argument construction, acceptability evaluation and conclusions.
source_claims.wag_implication: Test extraction, mapping and runtime semantics separately.

source_claims.paraphrase: Enforcement, synthesis, stability under future additions and explanation are distinct tasks with formalism-specific conditions.
source_claims.wag_implication: Winning or agreement is not source verification; declare the expansion model before claiming stability.

source_claims.paraphrase: Abstractions can introduce spurious acceptable sets; strong explanations have scoped preservation conditions.
source_claims.wag_implication: Check outcome preservation of explanation projections; retain full traces.

source_claims.paraphrase: Evidence combines basis, inference and purpose; relevance, admissibility, weight and sufficiency differ.
source_claims.wag_implication: Preserve claim-specific bindings and distinct assessment/admission semantics.

source_claims.paraphrase: Dialogue acceptance differs from private belief, and relying on another person’s report introduces credibility questions.
source_claims.wag_implication: Record public commitments and scoped assessment reasons rather than presumed mental states or blanket credibility.

source_claims.paraphrase: Linked, convergent and serial argumentative structures have different functions.
source_claims.wag_implication: Preserve joint premises, distinct support routes and premise reuse.

source_claims.paraphrase: The work is a theoretical method rather than a legal treatise and does not establish a general theory of scientific evidence.
source_claims.wag_implication: Do not turn historical legal examples into universal/current evidence rules.

source_claims.paraphrase: Expertise, field fit, assertion content, reliability, consistency and backup evidence differ; stronger dialogue diagnoses require a record of questioning.
source_claims.wag_implication: Keep criteria and dialogue duties distinct; an illustrative case is not controlled empirical validation.

source_claims.paraphrase: Prose conflicts with Figure 1’s expertise/exception structure; later prose mixes identifiers and figure numbering.
source_claims.wag_implication: Reconstruct graph fixtures independently; the discrepancy finding is specific to the supplied manuscript.

source_claims.paraphrase: Testimony depends on access, communication, consistency and credibility; agreement can reflect collusion or shared error.
source_claims.wag_implication: Preserve source assertions, account identity and evidence for independence.

source_claims.paraphrase: Corroborating paths and revised accounts can change support, but the diagrams and aggregation treatments are exploratory.
source_claims.wag_implication: No automatic numerical combination or inference from undercutting to substantive negation.
